items.headline: HHS proposes cutting most Head Start regulations, including staff-ratio standards
items.summary: Mixed for private operators: a lower-cost subsidized competitor, but disruption to 700-800k subsidized seats could shift families to private centers. 60-day comment window closes Oct 6.

items.headline: New Brookings report: child care costs continue to strain family budgets
items.summary: Reinforces a tuition ceiling — families already average ~20% of income on care vs the 7% affordability benchmark.

items.headline: Colorado pushes 7% family copay cap from Aug 2026 to Aug 2028
items.summary: Two more years before copayments are capped at 7% of income, deferring a revenue constraint for Colorado providers.
